Container.Name: SynCine
Container.Overview:
The film lover's companion, self-hosted. SynCiné brings your streaming services and your local cinemas together with your lists (watchlist, watched titles, ratings) and personalised recommendations. Family accounts, Plex / Jellyfin / Emby library and sign-in, Trakt and Letterboxd sync, Seerr requests, push notifications. Installable app (PWA) on phone, tablet and computer. Interface in English, French, Italian, German and Spanish.
Le compagnon des cinéphiles, auto-hébergé : streaming, cinémas, watchlist et recommandations, réunis dans une seule appli.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: cinesync movies films series watchlist trakt letterboxd plex jellyfin emby justwatch cinema showtimes recommendations

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: Interface port (HTTP). For HTTPS access (phone app, push notifications), put SynCiné behind a proxy (Tailscale serve, Nginx Proxy Manager, SWAG).

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: SynCiné database and daily backups (back it up).

Config.Name: Edition
Config.Description: server: an administrator and family accounts, with sign-in. personal: one person, no sign-in (trusted networks only).

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: HTTPS address you open SynCiné with (e.g. https://syncine.example.org). Used for Trakt sign-in and secure cookies. Leave empty on the local network.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Owner of the data files (99 = nobody on Unraid).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group of the data files (100 = users on Unraid).
